file_roles.evidence: Condition changed to 'if (!node->is_open())' with the old condition moved into ut_ad; adapts mariabackup to undo files now arriving already open.
fil_node_create(...) calls replaced by space->add(..., OS_FILE_CLOSED, ...) and dead log-file checks removed; API adaptation and cleanup, named 'remove some dead code' in the commit.
fil_node_open_file used to read page 0 then 'os_file_close(node->handle); node->handle = OS_FILE_CLOSED;' ; now keeps the handle open (read_page0 split out) and fil_space_t::add takes a handle.
fil_node_create replaced by space->add(it->m_filepath, OS_FILE_CLOSED, ...) plus a NULL check on fil_space_create; forced by the API change.
Same fil_node_create to space->add(..., OS_FILE_CLOSED, ...) replacement and NULL check.
Declares fil_space_t::add and fil_node_t::read_page0 and removes fil_node_create; header side of the fil0fil.cc change.

srv_undo_tablespace_open did 'ret = os_file_close(fh)' right after os_file_get_size and then fil_node_create(...) with a closed node; now calls space->add(name, fh, ...) so the undo file stays open with a handle.

rationale: Crash recovery asserted file->is_open() in recv_addr_trim because the undo tablespace file node had no handle. The reporter names srv_undo_tablespace_open() as opening and immediately closing the file, and the diff removes that close and passes the handle into the new fil_space_t::add. Other files are signature adaptation to that API, so I marked them refactor. The same close-after-page0 pattern also existed in fil_node_open_file, which is why fil0fil.cc is causal too.
